title: Let's build a Chatbot - More Settings, Refactorings and Database (Part 14)

cues.en: Hi, and welcome to part 14 of Let's Build a Chatbot in C-Sharp using Microsoft Agent Framework.
cues.zh: 大家好，歡迎來到使用 C# 與 Microsoft Agent Framework 打造聊天機器人的第十四部分。

cues.en: This is part 14, about more settings, refactorings, and real storage, because we're slowly getting
cues.zh: 第十四部分介紹更多設定、重構，以及真正的持久化儲存，因為我們慢慢接近，

cues.en: to the first natural end of this, where we have built it all in place of server.
cues.zh: 這個系列第一個自然的結束點，也就是完成 Blazor Server 版本。

cues.en: And we want to, at some point, be able to deploy this as well.
cues.zh: 之後也希望能夠部署。

cues.en: But before we do that, I wanted to go in and do some more settings, some more refactorings,
cues.zh: 但在那之前，想先加入更多設定、進行一些重構，

cues.en: and turn into real storage using Cosmos DB and some blob storage.
cues.zh: 再改成使用 Cosmos DB 與 Blob Storage 的真正儲存。

cues.en: Because before we were running, we had our LLM and secrets in app host parameters that was just user secrets.
cues.zh: 原本 LLM 與秘密值放在 AppHost 參數中，背後就是 User Secrets。

cues.en: But the attachment we put into app data, and the generated images we put into VVV root.
cues.zh: 附件放在 AppData，生成圖片則放在 wwwroot。

cues.en: And the conversation settings were just put in either local storage or in temp folders on the machine.
cues.zh: 對話與設定則放在 LocalStorage，或電腦的暫存資料夾。

cues.en: So it could run on a local Windows machine, but it couldn't really run up in the cloud
cues.zh: 因此可以在本機 Windows 執行，但無法妥善放到雲端，

cues.en: had we made a publish of it, because those temp folders were ephemeral, and we wouldn't
cues.zh: 因為即使發布，這些暫存資料夾也可能隨時消失，無法，

cues.en: be able to ensure that things were being saved.
cues.zh: 確保資料持續保存。

cues.en: The same goes for app data and VVV root.
cues.zh: AppData 與 wwwroot 也有類似問題。

cues.en: So what we were going to cover today is that we have taken the LLM secrets, then we have
cues.zh: 所以今天要處理的是：LLM 的秘密值，

cues.en: retained here, because we want them to just be in user secrets.
cues.zh: 目前保持不變，因為希望仍然放在 User Secrets。

cues.en: When we deploy, we might go with a keyword or not, depending on what we need.
cues.zh: 部署時，會依需求決定是否改用 Key Vault。

cues.en: Attachments and generated images are now up in Azure Blob Storage.
cues.zh: 附件與生成圖片，現在移到 Azure Blob Storage。

cues.en: And conversations and settings are now stored in Cosmos DB.
cues.zh: 對話與設定則改存 Cosmos DB。

cues.en: So another thing is the refactoring part.
cues.zh: 另一部分是重構。

cues.en: I will go into these things a bit more in detail in one second.
cues.zh: 稍後會更詳細介紹這些內容。

cues.en: But another thing was that when we build a Blazor server, what typically happens is that
cues.zh: 建立 Blazor Server 時，通常會出現這種情況：

cues.en: when we are in an Aspire, we have a small app host that takes care of parameters.
cues.zh: 在 Aspire 中，有一個小型 AppHost，負責參數設定。

cues.en: We have surface default that takes care of a few dependency injections, in our case, the dependency injection against the agent framework toolkit.
cues.zh: ServiceDefaults 則負責一些相依性注入，這裡主要是 Agent Framework Toolkit。

cues.en: And then we end up with a Blazor server that have a bunch of visuals and logic up here for various different systems.
cues.zh: 最後 Blazor Server 裡，堆了各種系統的畫面與邏輯。

cues.en: And I wanted to change that so that the Blazor server were more or less only visuals.
cues.zh: 我想調整成，Blazor Server 基本上只保留介面。

cues.en: And we put in a lot of the data that was up here and put them down into the surface default.
cues.zh: 把原本上面的很多資料與邏輯，移到 ServiceDefaults。

cues.en: So a lot of the logic and keeping the dependency injections down here.
cues.zh: 因此共用邏輯與相依性注入，都放在下面。

cues.en: And the reason I'm doing this is for the next iteration of let's build a chatbot where we actually want to build other frontends and other backends.
cues.zh: 原因是下一階段的聊天機器人系列，會建立其他前端與後端。

cues.en: And if we are to leverage what we have done so far and not just reinvent the wheel or
cues.zh: 如果要重複使用目前成果，而不是重新發明輪子，或，

cues.en: copy-paste, we need to have them in a system where it's independent on what the frontend and the backend is.
cues.zh: 到處複製，就需要把程式碼放在不依賴特定前後端的位置。

cues.en: So I put a lot of things down into server defaults.
cues.zh: 因此很多內容都移到 ServiceDefaults。

cues.en: We will see that in one second.
cues.zh: 稍後會看到。

cues.en: So we at some point can build an ASP.NET Core backend and a frontend in other tools, probably in React.
cues.zh: 之後就能建立 ASP.NET Core 後端，以及使用其他技術、可能是 React 的前端。

cues.en: So we have just prepared a lot of things in here.
cues.zh: 現在先做好相關準備。

cues.en: This means that we needed to have some online resources for the first part, that we didn't just want them in folders.
cues.zh: 第一部分需要一些線上資源，不再只把資料放在資料夾。

cues.en: So I've made a Cosmos DB account, just a free tier.
cues.zh: 因此我建立了 Cosmos DB 帳號，使用免費層級。

cues.en: So you can do this more or less for free.
cues.zh: 所以大致可以免費使用。

cues.en: There's a storage account and of course pay for storage, but that's pennies.
cues.zh: 另有 Storage Account，當然儲存需要費用，但很便宜。

cues.en: So it shouldn't be too much.
cues.zh: 成本應該不高。

cues.en: The Cosmos DB will be auto-setup if you just provide a connection string, but it ends up
cues.zh: 只要提供連線字串，Cosmos DB 會自動設定，最後建立，

cues.en: with a database called chatbots and two containers, one for conversations and one for settings.
cues.zh: 名為 chatbots 的資料庫，以及 conversations、settings 兩個容器。

cues.en: So you can see here, if I have four different conversations, there will be four different things here.
cues.zh: 這裡可以看到，如果有四段對話，就會有四筆資料。

cues.en: And each of them are linked to a user, so each user gets their own.
cues.zh: 每筆都關聯到使用者，因此各自取得自己的對話。

cues.en: And that's just the message we had in a JSON file before, now it's just up in Cosmos.
cues.zh: 內容就是原本 JSON 檔案中的資料，現在搬到 Cosmos DB。

cues.en: The settings, same way, we just store one record per user, so we can have the information from that user.
cues.zh: 設定也相同，每個使用者一筆，保存該使用者的資訊。

cues.en: Finally, we made a storage account, and in that there's two blob storages, an attachment
cues.zh: 最後建立 Storage Account，其中有兩個 Blob 容器：attachments，

cues.en: and a generated images.
cues.zh: 以及 generated-images。

cues.en: So here, the images and PDF, we end up adding to attachment and the images we make for generation
cues.zh: 上傳的圖片與 PDF 放在 attachments，生成的圖片，

cues.en: will be stored up here.
cues.zh: 則放在這裡。

cues.en: So we are completely independent of the machine things are running on.
cues.zh: 因此完全不依賴執行系統的那台機器。

cues.en: And again, when we build multiple backends and fronts, we can actually use the same data,
cues.zh: 同樣地，未來建立多種前後端時，也能使用相同資料，

cues.en: same conversations, same attachments, same generated images.
cues.zh: 相同對話、附件與生成圖片。

cues.en: Visual-wise, if you were to go into the repo and run the code, it will not look anything different.
cues.zh: 如果下載儲存庫執行，介面看起來沒有什麼不同。

cues.en: Things have just been moved around, but the visuals itself is not any different, and these images are then hosted up in blob storage.
cues.zh: 只是內容移了位置，畫面不變，這些圖片則改由 Blob Storage 提供。

cues.en: These conversations are saved in Cosmos DB, the settings are saved in Cosmos DB.
cues.zh: 對話與設定都保存到 Cosmos DB。

cues.en: The only real change that's visual is that there's a few more of these settings.
cues.zh: 視覺上唯一明顯變更，是多了一些設定。

cues.en: So you can choose if you want to show reasoning, want to show tokens, want to show tool calls, and want to show the memory updates.
cues.zh: 可以選擇是否顯示推理、Token、工具呼叫，以及記憶更新。

cues.en: The final thing I'll put in is a new danger zone.
cues.zh: 最後加入新的 Danger Zone。

cues.en: So because now, if someone were to use this, they can't really just go to their temp folder and delete what was previously set, and memories, and so on.
cues.zh: 因為現在使用者不能直接進暫存資料夾，刪除先前的設定、記憶等內容。

cues.en: So now there is a small setting that you can get rid of all your conversations and settings, and that will, of course, delete them up in the cloud.
cues.zh: 因此加入功能，可以移除所有對話與設定，當然也會刪除雲端資料。

cues.en: App host-wise, we had three parameters, the Azure endpoint and key, and then the weather service.
cues.zh: AppHost 原本有三個參數：Azure 端點、金鑰，以及天氣服務金鑰。

cues.en: And now we have extended that, of course, in order to get a blob storage connection string, and a Cosmos DB connection string.
cues.zh: 現在當然也加入 Blob Storage 與 Cosmos DB 連線字串。

cues.en: And then comes the big changes in the refactoring of the code, which have taken quite a while to get right, but we saw in the past that the Blazor server had a lot of different things.
cues.zh: 接著是花了不少時間整理的程式碼重構。原本 Blazor Server 包含很多東西。

cues.en: It had AI contact providers, it had the layout and pages, of course, it had some extensions
cues.zh: 有 AI Context Provider、版面與頁面，也有一些擴充方法，

cues.en: that were more or less Entry ID-specific and Agent Framework-specific.
cues.zh: 分別與 Entra ID、Agent Framework 有關。

cues.en: It had a bunch of models, services, and tools.
cues.zh: 還有大量模型、服務與工具。

cues.en: And inside the program, all of these needed to be wired up, and all logic were up in the Blazor server.
cues.zh: Program 中需要把它們全部串接起來，所有邏輯都在 Blazor Server。

cues.en: Now, you can see we only really have layout and pages left, and a few new models to keep track of the visual state of things.
cues.zh: 現在只剩下 Layout、Pages，以及幾個記錄介面狀態的新模型。

cues.en: So, what have the user input, and what are their attachments in memory right now, before we save them up into the cloud?
cues.zh: 例如使用者輸入，以及上傳雲端之前，記憶體中有哪些附件。

cues.en: And I made a new visual state to keep track of all the things of currently streaming, and so on and so forth.
cues.zh: 也建立新的 VisualState，記錄目前串流等各種狀態。

cues.en: There's only one local storage key left, which is dark mode, and the program is more or less empty.
cues.zh: LocalStorage 只剩深色模式一個鍵值，Program 也幾乎是空的。

cues.en: It's just visuals now.
cues.zh: 現在只負責介面。

cues.en: And all this code has now gone into the service defaults of the solution, where we only had
cues.zh: 其他程式碼移到方案的 ServiceDefaults。原本這裡只有，

cues.en: the small extension where we did a little bit about dependency injection of the Agent
cues.zh: 少量相依性注入擴充方法，處理 Agent，

cues.en: Framework toolkit and the weather service, and we had some keys for that, some constants.
cues.zh: Framework Toolkit 與天氣服務，以及一些金鑰常數。

cues.en: Now, we have the contact providers that we had over here.
cues.zh: 現在，原本那邊的 Context Provider 也搬過來。

cues.en: They have been moved over, so it can be used in multiple backends.
cues.zh: 因此可以在多種後端使用。

cues.en: Constants for the AI models have just been drawn out of all the code over here, so it's easier to get to.
cues.zh: AI 模型常數，也從各處程式碼抽出來，方便集中管理。

cues.en: The customer's ID, names of things, and the secret keys we had in the past here.
cues.zh: 還有自訂 ID、各種名稱，以及先前使用的秘密值鍵名。

cues.en: All the extensions have more or less just been moved over from over here.
cues.zh: 大部分擴充方法，都是直接從那邊移過來。

cues.en: All the models have been moved over and cleaned up a bit, so we got one big settings instead
cues.zh: 所有模型也移過來，並稍微整理，改成一個完整設定物件，而不是，

cues.en: of various different things that were in various different places of settings.
cues.zh: 讓不同設定分散在各個位置。

cues.en: And then we put all the services over here, so the agent service in order to generate, for example, the title of a conversation is saved over here because we probably need to
cues.zh: 接著把服務都放在這裡。例如產生對話標題的 AgentService，因為其他地方也可能需要，

cues.en: make a conversation title in other places as well.
cues.zh: 產生對話標題。

cues.en: The blob storage service is just normal blob storage from Azure, nothing fancy there.
cues.zh: BlobStorageService 就是一般 Azure Blob Storage，沒有特別處理。

cues.en: Conversational chat message mapper is the one we had over here before, but there was nothing laser-specific in it, so we moved it.
cues.zh: ConversationChatMessageMapper 原本在那邊，但沒有任何 Blazor 專屬邏輯，因此移過來。

cues.en: Conversation service has been rewired, of course, instead of having files and folders to be the Cosmos DB.
cues.zh: ConversationService 當然也改寫，從檔案與資料夾，改成 Cosmos DB。

cues.en: Image generation service has been moved out of image generation tool here, so it can independently be used as a service and a tool.
cues.zh: 圖像生成服務從工具中抽出來，方便同時作為服務與工具使用。

cues.en: They could be linked together, but if we need to do something special with image generation, it's its own service now, and setting services, of course, as well.
cues.zh: 兩者可以互相串接，但如果要特別處理圖像生成，現在有獨立服務，SettingsService 也是。

cues.en: So the extension just got a bit more dependency injections.
cues.zh: 因此相依性注入的擴充方法，多了幾項註冊。

cues.en: But beyond that, everything should more or less now be ready to have a deployment, which we'll cover in a separate video.
cues.zh: 除此之外，現在大致已準備好部署，會用另一支影片介紹。

cues.en: I might add a few more features before we do that, but else this is kind of the first season of Let's Build a Chatbot coming to an end very soon.
cues.zh: 在那之前也許再加幾個功能，但聊天機器人系列的第一季，應該很快就會結束。

cues.en: And also because of summer, I will take a little break before we see season two of this.
cues.zh: 也因為夏天到了，第二季開始之前會先休息一下。

cues.en: So there might only be one or two videos left here until we wait a bit, and the next videos will be in August.
cues.zh: 因此可能只剩一、兩支影片，之後暫停，下一批會在八月。

cues.en: But so far, so good.
cues.zh: 目前進度很好。

cues.en: If you want to see any of the details, of course, just go to the repo, rwjchatbot, and there you can go in and grab the code.
cues.zh: 如果想查看細節，可以到 rwjchatbot 儲存庫，下載程式碼。

cues.en: And if you want to see previous sessions, they are in different branches.
cues.zh: 先前單元則保存在不同分支。

cues.en: So it's not like you can't go back to some of the previous versions if you don't like being dependent on the cloud.
cues.zh: 所以如果不喜歡依賴雲端，仍然可以回到之前版本。

cues.en: You can still see the previous versions up there.
cues.zh: 舊版本都還在。

cues.en: So with that, thank you for this time and see you in the next one.
cues.zh: 感謝觀看，下一支影片見。
